paper_title: An Output Sensitive Algorithm for Maximal Clique Enumeration in Sparse Graphs
statement: We presented the first output sensitive algorithm for maximal clique enumeration whose enumeration time depends only on the degeneracy of the graph. We were not able to prove that it has polynomial time delay. Our intuition is that in its current state, our algorithm has time delay O(kα). Thus, we first ask whether this is true or not and if yes, if there is a way to modify our approach as to get a polynomial time delay. The second question that we ask is whether or not we can improve the space complexity. In its current state, our algorithm requires that the maximal cliques be stored. Can we modify our approach as to avoid that?
